acceptance_criteria.description: Unapproved private sources fail closed; explicitly approved projections expose only schema-whitelisted typed facts and no materialized private assets.
Every source and observation pins immutable repository commit, root tree, normalizer, result blob, SHA-256, byte size, conditions, denominator, and limitations.
Generated catalog and observations tables expose every audited BiomniBench and CMT aggregate row while NatureBranch absence and upstream references remain distinct.
Historical import validation, focused tests, ledger exports, secret and host-path scans, collaboration validation, lab doctor, and diff checks pass.

objective: Publish only explicitly authorized typed BiomniBench-DA, CMTBench, and NatureBench result facts as provenance-bound legacy observations while private artifacts remain excluded.
title: Publish historical result facts in the unified ledger
